ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels (~90% surface area) punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and linear segments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity base across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity circular spots (5-15 pixel diameter) and multi-directional linear segments (1-3 pixel width) are distributed non-uniformly across the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile. The left distal tip exhibits a blunt, jagged truncation. The right distal tip exhibits a protruding, high-texture appendage. The trailing edge between the tips and notch shows low-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave lower-to-mid sweep transitioning into convex upper trajectories toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity ovoid and circular rings (approx. 20+ instances) scattered across the medial and distal regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (criss-crossing rake marks) varying in length and orientation across the entire visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant distal tip irregularity on the left lobe and a cluster of protruding, high-intensity textured material (potential barnacle colony or traumatic tissue) on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical high-intensity pixel band is located at the fluke base (peduncle junction) at the water-line interface.
